Package com.composum.platform.commons.proxy

Interface ProxyManagerService

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    ProxyManagerServiceImpl
    public interface ProxyManagerService
    Central access point for all configured ProxyServices - helper to use HTTP(S) proxies to access remote systems.

        void initHttpContext​(@NotNull
                     @NotNull String proxyKey,
                     @NotNull
                     @NotNull org.apache.http.client.protocol.HttpClientContext context,
                     @Nullable

              throws IllegalArgumentException,
                     javax.jcr.RepositoryException
        Initializes the HttpClientContext with the information about the proxy.
        Parameters:
        proxyKey - the systemwide unique key for the proxy
        context - the context to be initialized
        resolver - a resolver for authentication purposes, if credentials are needed.
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if there was no proxy with the given proxyKey or there was a problem with it's credential configuration
